premises.text: Robots are constrained by hardware rather than brains, sensors, or software.
premises.evidence_span: they're instead constrained by the hardware.

premises.text: Affordable and accessible quality hardware can increase the pace of innovation in robotics.
premises.evidence_span: if more people can afford and access quality hardware, then the pace of innovation can be massively increased.

premises.text: Modbot provides common building blocks for robot construction.
premises.evidence_span: Modbot identifies the common building blocks found in all robots.

premises.text: Modbot allows for easy hardware programming and rapid prototyping.
premises.evidence_span: you can use our phone app to do hardware programming on the fly, record keyframes, and repeat sequences wirelessly.

premises.text: Modbot enables users to assemble and program robots in a virtual environment.
premises.evidence_span: Modbot puts your ideas into the cloud with our virtual robot builder.

premises.text: Modbot's integrated design reduces costs and improves compactness and weight efficiency.
premises.evidence_span: we've managed to reduce the cost of an industrial equivalent by about one-tenth.

premises.text: Modbot can revolutionize robot building and accessibility for small businesses.
premises.evidence_span: we believe that this will revolutionise the way that robots are built and who they're built by.

value.text: Modbot makes robot building accessible to everyday inventors and small businesses.
value.evidence_span: we want to make really accessible with ModBot.

notes: No separate premises for specific robot examples as they illustrate the same premise of accessibility and innovation.
